author: blekek.k
title: Hiring illustrators for trading card project
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. We're looking for artists that draws: Anime / manga style illustrations; Cartoon / semi-cartoon illustration; Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork; Semi-realistic illustrations; and any other art styles. Comment if you're interested or DM me directly! Follow-up from author: thanks for reaching out, will check portfolios; if you have not sent a portfolio, provide a link to previous works.

author: Veli Raiya
title: Seeking fantasy map designer and character illustrator
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely doesn't have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you're a fantasy author recommending someone you've personally worked with. See the next posts for more details. Character art: realistic, epic fantasy concept art rather than cartoon; lighter fantasy but grounded and lifelike; open to different styles; bonus for POC and a wide variety of ethnicities. Needs portraits for now, more if the style fits the series. Map: detailed and immersive classic fantasy-map feel, open stylistically. Contact: reply on the thread or DM.
